story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯车队通报：比赛重启后一号弯发生碰撞，安全车再度出动
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上通报，第35圈比赛重启后车群在进入一号弯时发生碰撞，兰多退赛，乔治保持第一，基米升至第七，安全车再次出动。
story.originalTitle: Lap 35/51: We’re back racing! 🟢 There’s a collision between the pack into T1, Lando is out. George stays in P1 and Kimi is now up to P7 the Safet...
story.summaryEn:
Lap 35/51: We’re back racing! 🟢
There’s a collision between the pack into T1, Lando is out. 
George stays in P1 and Kimi is now up to P7 the Safety car is back out.
detailZh:
第35圈/共51圈：比赛重启！🟢
车群在进入一号弯时发生碰撞，兰多退赛。
乔治保持第一位，基米升至第七位，安全车再次出动。
detailEn:
Lap 35/51: We’re back racing! 🟢
There’s a collision between the pack into T1, Lando is out. 
George stays in P1 and Kimi is now up to P7 the Safety car is back out.
keyPointsZh: 比赛共51圈，当时进行到第35圈
乔治保持第一位，基米升至第七位
keyPointsEn: The race was on lap 35 of 51 at the time
Lando was out of the race in the incident
George stayed in P1 and Kimi moved up to P7
